title: ESDS Q2 Profit Zooms 41% YoY To ₹31.1 Cr, Revenue Up 48%
hook_before: ESDS Software Solution just reported a 41 percent jump in profit.
script:
ESDS Software Solution just beat last year by forty one percent.
The company reached 31.1 crore rupees in consolidated net profit.
Quarterly revenue climbed by 48 percent compared to last year.
ESDS provides enterprise cloud and AI services for businesses.
Piyush Somani leads the firm as Managing Director.
This growth shows heavy demand for their specialized cloud infrastructure.
Could this profit streak continue through the next quarter?
